lines.1: Even in ordinary situations, Inori has stopped talking to me much.
lines.2: She never blatantly ignores me, but I can tell she's avoiding me on purpose.
lines.3: Damn. The more I press, the more she retreats.
lines.4: 「Subaru, beware... Adult women are masters of maneuvering.」
lines.5: 「I know. I feel it in my bones.」
lines.7: 「Want all the overflowing love I can offer?」
lines.8: 「You always joke like that. What if I took you seriously?」
lines.9: 「What would I do? I wouldn't treat you badly.」
lines.10: I'm starting to find him genuinely hard to understand.
lines.11: That was a joke too, right?
lines.13: 「By 'give me something,' I meant advice! How to win over an older woman!」
lines.14: 「If I knew that, I'd use it myself.」
lines.18: If she won't speak to me normally, I'll exploit her position as a teacher.
lines.21: 「So this translates as, 'Neckties are unnecessary in places such as this.'」
lines.23: 「Ma'am, I have a question as your student.」
lines.26: 「Did you always intend to become a teacher?」
lines.27: 「Yes. I was determined to become one.」
lines.28: Oh, there must be some reason.
lines.30: 「There is no need to tell you. I have a right to privacy.」
lines.36: 「Come now, it is time to leave school.」
